text: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Edward Francis Small Teaching Hospital Banjul and data was effectively collected from August to October 2023. A structured data collection tool was used. The data was entered into a computer database and analyzed using the SPSS version 26. Pain was graded using a 10-cm visual analogue scale. Results were expressed in simple descriptive statistics and test of significance was set at p-value 0.05.
source_label: Prevalence of dural puncture headache after caesarean section at a tertiary hospital in the Gambia
